**Latin – the Late‑/Medieval Latin that Charlemagne’s court used**

The surname *Sylvester* derives from the Latin adjective *silvestris* (“of the forest”).  The form of Latin that produced this name is the **Late Latin** period, the stage of the Latin language that was in use from the late 3rd century onward and that continued throughout the Early Middle Ages.  Charlemagne, who was crowned Roman Emperor in 800 CE, wrote in this Late Latin; the later tradition (especially during the High Middle Ages) often refers to it simply as **Medieval Latin**.
